value.rationale: The sharp threshold of possible entire growth is a natural invariant for the long-standing cofinite derivative-zero question. An order-one witness versus finite-type impossibility identifies a genuine structural boundary not furnished by the earlier order-two existence theorem, and the answer applies over all open sets and all eventually large derivative orders.
